newsitem.title: USA: NorAm Gaming says will raise $2 mln.
newsitem.headline: NorAm Gaming says will raise $2 mln.

text.p: NorAm Gaming & Entertainment Corp said Wednesday it signed a letter of intent with C. Ron Gray of S.F.N. Capital Corp of New York whereby S.F.N. Capital will raise $2 million.
NorAm said closing of the financing with S.F.N., a privately-held company, is expected within 45 days.
NorAm said it will use the funds to set up a distribution network to market the "Vaprel" line of bingo equipment as well as a showroom in Las Vegas to showcase the line.
The company said further use of the funds will include the retiring of bridge loans, totaling $215,000, which will leave it debt free.
